scope: All reviewed usable answers in the supplied end-to-end run. No production accuracy or model-only accuracy is inferred.

definitions.resources: Reported response tokens only, not a billing total; absent usage is unknown, not zero. Search attempts include cache/budget checks; adapter dispatches are separate and are not invoice credits. Attachment preparation and unreported failed responses are outside turn usage.
definitions.claimPrecision: supported / (supported + unsupported + unverifiable), reviewed usable answers only; inference excluded
definitions.taskSuccess: Explicit reviewed taskSuccess labels; not inferred from terminal status or keyword checks
definitions.latency: Useful-answer medians exclude failed, cancelled, empty and evidence-only fallback responses; quota waits are reported separately
